recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit. If PA later wants periods attached to individual role codings, open a new modeling issue rather than changing this reconciliation, because FHIR-29929 explicitly accepted multiple RelatedPerson instances for that case.
issue_request: FHIR-29929 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested changing RelatedPerson.relationship into a BackboneElement with role, relation, and period fields; the final resolution instead said FHIR-15841 standardized role and relationship in Patient.contact and RelatedPerson, and that role-period needs can be represented with multiple RelatedPerson instances.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-29929 source commit was found. Commit 3b17466cd4311c8b261c00e1796fe76c1f303784 for FHIR-26994 clarified RelatedPerson.relationship directionality and says it also covered FHIR-29929. The substantive role/relationship split cited by the Jira resolution was applied by FHIR-15841 commit 23f3b0abec5678767e3cc7e4b576fdbd3e3b9fb2, which added Patient.contact.role and RelatedPerson.role and revised relationship semantics to personal relationships.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists patient=Patient and relatedperson=RelatedPerson. Current RelatedPerson source has RelatedPerson.relationship for personal relationships, RelatedPerson.role for functional roles, and RelatedPerson.period for the instance period. Current Patient.contact source mirrors the relationship/role split. PA Confluence minutes for the 2021 September WGM align with the Jira resolution by treating FHIR-29929 as handled through FHIR-15841. Existing combined-branch audits for FHIR-31670 and FHIR-32230 also confirm FHIR-15841 as the current governing model for RelatedPerson role value set binding.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already conveys the final modified decision: do not embed role, relation, and period inside RelatedPerson.relationship; use separate personal relationship and functional role elements, and use separate RelatedPerson instances when different periods are needed.
